description: This Python source file implements a Gemini-specific retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ingestion class, handling document storage and upload to Gemini's File Search API with customized chunking, metadata, and resumable uploads.

classes.name: GeminiRAGIngestion
classes.description: A subclass of BaseRAGIngestion tailored for Gemini. Handles creating file search stores, uploading files with resumable uploads, and bypassing embedding steps, optimized for Gemini's API.

methods.name: Optional[List[List[float]]] embed( self, chunks: List[str], )
methods.description: Overrides base method; Gemini handles embedding internally, so this method returns None.

methods.description: Stores the file content and metadata in Gemini's File Search Store via API calls, managing creation and upload of files.
